annotation_description: Playing Mountain instead of Inspiring Vantage on turn 1 is suboptimal. Inspiring Vantage enters untapped when you control two or fewer other lands, so playing it on turn 1 guarantees it enters untapped. Later, if you play it as your third or later land, it might enter tapped. Mountain always enters untapped regardless of when you play it. By playing Mountain now, you risk having Inspiring Vantage enter tapped later. Additionally, with Hired Claw (a red 1-drop) in hand, either land would let you cast it, so there's no downside to playing Inspiring Vantage first — it produces red mana and preserves flexibility for future turns.

Declined to use Full Bore on Hired Claw during combat when the opponent has no blockers and no untapped mana. This would have dealt 3 extra damage (4 instead of 1 from combat). While saving Full Bore for potential warp synergy with Nova Hellkite later has merit, the opponent is completely unable to interact, making this a low-risk opportunity to push significant early damage.

Casting a burn spell to face instead of the Nova Hellkite from exile (warp {2}{R}). The Hellkite provides 4 flying haste damage, gets exiled at end step for reuse on future turns, and is strictly more damage than either burn spell. Burn spells could be saved for future turns when mana is available alongside the Hellkite.

Casting Nova Hellkite for Warp during postcombat main accomplishes nothing meaningful - there are no opposing creatures for the ETB trigger, it can't attack this turn, and it gets exiled at end step. Meanwhile, the player has exactly enough mana (RRW) to cast both Lightning Helix (RW) and Burst Lightning (R) targeting the opponent for 5 total damage plus 3 life gain, putting the opponent to 9.

Gem3F Hype has Burst Lightning in hand, one untapped Sunbillow Verge, and the opponent is at 14 life. They have Emberheart Challenger on board (which has prowess). Casting Burst Lightning targeting the opponent would deal 2 damage (putting them to 12) and trigger prowess on Emberheart Challenger, making it 3/3 until end of turn. While this is post-combat so the prowess pump wouldn't matter for attacks this turn, the 2 damage to face is still value, and holding it doesn't gain much since the opponent has no creatures to target. However, saving Burst Lightning for a future creature removal or for a turn where it can trigger prowess before combat is reasonable. The bigger miss is Full Bore - with Sunbillow Verge untapped producing R, they could cast Full Bore on Emberheart Challenger post-combat... but again it's post-combat so the +3/+2 doesn't help. Passing is defensible since using burn spells post-combat wastes prowess triggers, but Burst Lightning to the face for 2 free damage with unused mana is a small missed opportunity.

Emberheart Challenger is about to die to Requiting Hex. By casting Full Bore targeting Emberheart Challenger in response, they could trigger Valiant (exile top card, play it this turn) for free card advantage, since Full Bore loses most of its value once the creature dies anyway. The Valiant trigger would resolve before the Hex destroys the creature.

Nova Hellkite is attacking unblocked into an opponent at 10 life with Full Bore in hand and one untapped red source. Casting Full Bore would deal 7 instead of 4, putting the opponent to 3 life where Burst Lightning would be lethal next turn. Instead, they dealt only 4, leaving the opponent at 6.

With Sacred Foundry untapped, Gem3F Hype could have cast Full Bore on Nova Hellkite during combat to deal 7 damage instead of 4, putting the opponent to 3 life. At 3 life, Burst Lightning next turn would be lethal. Instead, the opponent stays at 6 life, requiring much more work to close out the game.

Gem3F Hype has Burst Lightning in hand and the opponent is at 6 life. Nova Hellkite is tapped (just attacked) and will be exiled at end step since it was cast for its warp cost. With Sacred Foundry untapped, they have exactly 1 mana available to cast Burst Lightning for 2 damage to the opponent's face, bringing them to 4 life. While that alone isn't lethal, the critical issue is that Nova Hellkite is about to be exiled anyway, so there's no reason not to use the available mana. However, looking more carefully: Sacred Foundry is the only untapped land (1 mana). Burst Lightning costs {R} and deals 2 damage. The opponent is at 6 life. 2 damage brings them to 4. This isn't lethal, but it's free damage with no downside since there's nothing else productive to do with 1 mana and the Hellkite is leaving anyway. Declining to cast Burst Lightning here wastes an opportunity to deal 2 damage for free when the opponent is at 6 life - every point matters at this stage.

Gem3F Hype has Burst Lightning in hand and the opponent is at 6 life. Nova Hellkite (4/5) is on the battlefield and attacked this turn (it's tapped). At end of turn, Burst Lightning deals 2 damage, bringing the opponent to 4 life. Next turn, Nova Hellkite attacks for 4, which is exactly lethal. However, more importantly, Gem3F Hype could also cast Full Bore on Nova Hellkite (making it 7/7) but it's already tapped so that doesn't help right now. The key issue is that Burst Lightning to face right now (2 damage, opponent goes to 4) sets up lethal next turn with the 4-power Nova Hellkite. But the opponent has untapped lands (Multiversal Passage and Restless Reef) and cards in hand that could include removal. Casting Burst Lightning now at end of turn to put the opponent to 4 is strictly better than not casting it - it costs only 1 mana and there's no reason to hold it. The opponent is at 6 life and every point of damage matters. By declining to cast Burst Lightning at end of turn, Gem3F Hype is missing guaranteed damage that could set up lethal or force the opponent into a worse position.

Gem3F Hype missed lethal. Nova Hellkite (4 power) attacking + Burst Lightning (2 damage) to face = exactly 6 damage, which is the opponent's life total. By passing priority, they gave the opponent the chance to activate Restless Reef as a 4/4 deathtouch blocker, potentially killing Nova Hellkite and preventing the 4 combat damage.
